source.author: cic
source.text_english: He is gone, he has departed, he has escaped, he has burst forth.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: ego, ego uidi hoc aliquando portentum et testimoniis scripturarum quasi uinculis Hippocratis uolui ligare furiosum, sed abiit, excessit, euasit, erupit et inter Arriae fluctus Cottiique regis Alpes in nos declamando clamauit.
reuse.text_original: ego, ego uidi hoc aliquando portentum et testimoniis scripturarum quasi uinculis Hippocratis uolui ligare furiosum, sed abiit, excessit, euasit, erupit et inter Arriae fluctus Cottiique regis Alpes in nos declamando clamauit.
reuse.text_english: I, I once saw this monster too, and I wanted to bind the madman with the testimonies of the Scriptures as with the chains of Hippocrates, but he went away, departed, escaped, broke loose, and amid the waves of Arrius and the Alps of King Cottius he shouted at us in declamation.
